target: After another hour of constantly rushing towards his goal, only stopping every few minutes to make sure his heading was correct, Sam finally stopped at a clearing, as even his prodigious Mana Regeneration couldn’t keep up with his use of Shadow Cloak.

source: As he stood, resting a little bit, he had a decision to make.
target: Dum stabat, paulo requiescens, decisionem capere debebat.

source: Either he waited for his mana to regenerate and then continue, or go ahead without using it.
target: Aut exspectavit ut regeneratio manae eius eveniret et deinde pergeret, aut sine ea procederet.

source: It wasn’t like he was in a real rush…
target: Non enim vere festinabat…

source: Yes, the guilds were trying to hunt the trolls into extinction in their greed for the skill book that everybody wanted, but they were pretty far from reaching the area where he was headed.
target: Ita, collegia conabantur trollos ad exstinctionem venari, insatiabili cupiditate pro libro peritiae, quem omnes desiderabant; sed longe ab eo loco, ad quem se dirigeret, erant.

source: But still, currently, most players were dedicated and hardcore gamers.
target: Sed tamen, nunc, plerique lusores erant devoti et ardenter ludentes.

source: Gamers only like a few things: finding secrets, collecting loot, and being the first.
target: Lusores solum paucis rebus delectantur: arcana detegere, praeda colligere, et primus esse.

source: And nothing attracted curious and fame‐hungry gamers more than a secret area.
target: Nec quidquam altius lusores curiosos atque fama avidos alliciebat quam locus arcanus.

source: No matter how much something is hidden, somebody, somewhere, would find it.
target: Quamvis aliquid celatum sit, aliquis, alicubi, id inveniet.

source: And Sam couldn’t allow someone to overtake him.
target: Et Sam non permittere potuit ut aliquis eum superaret.

source: Feeling as if his breathing was coming under control, he turned to his status screen and clicked around the settings for a little while.
target: Sentiens quasi spiritus eius sub moderamine esset, ad scrinium status conversus est et paulisper per optiones premebat.

source: Sam would be going into a high‐stakes environment, and he didn’t want to be distracted by a wrongly timed pop‐up.
target: Sam in ambitum magnum periculi ingredietur, neque volebat ab apparitione intempestiva, tempore errato, distrahi.

source: So, he turned off the skill level‐up notifications and only left those that would inform him of status effects and the like.
target: Itaque notificationes de incremento artis interclusit et solum eas reliquit quae eum de effectibus status et similia certiores facerent.

source: Thankfully, the game had the option to set a notification profile, as well as the capability to save multiple profiles.
target: Fortunatim, ludus optionem habebat ad constituendum profilium notificationum, necnon facultatem plurimorum profilorum salvandorum.

source: He set the current one as Basic and the new one as High Tempo.
target: Praesentem Basic et novum High Tempo constituit.

source: Then he did a few stretches, checked his equipment for the last time and, without activating his Shadow Cloak, shot off again in the direction of the forest where the Chalice was said to be hidden.
target: Deinde aliquot exercitationes fecit, supellectilem ultima inspecta, et, sine usu pallii umbratilis, iterum in directionem silvae properavit, ubi dicitur Calix lateare.

source: Sam pivoted, slashing down with his sword, bisecting the giant grasshopper of all things, then at the same time jumped back as another launched itself at him.
target: Sam circumversus est, gladio suo ictum habens, gigantem locustam in duas partes secans, simulque retro saltavit, cum alter ad eum impetum daret.

source: He didn’t have to react as Lucky crashed into the grasshopper with an eager howl.
target: Non oportuit eum agere, cum Lucky in locustam impetuoso ululatu irrueret.

source: He didn’t even get to watch the carnage unfolding as, with an eerie sound, several more grasshoppers jumped at him from behind several bushes, and he was once again in a fight for his life.
target: Neve spectare potuit effusionem caedis, cum, sonitu infausto, plures locustae ex post aliquot frondis insiliebant, atque iterum in pugna pro vita sua versaretur.

source: “Why grasshoppers?” but the only answer to his question were cricket sounds in the background.
target: “Cur locustae?” sed sola responsio quaestionis eius erant soni cicadarum in fundo.

source: He just sighed at the stupidity and went back to massacring the giant, unnatural grasshoppers as they tried to aggressively hop at him and Lucky.
target: Ob stultitiam simplex suspiravit et rediit ad trucidandas locustas gigantes, inusitatas, quatenus vehementer in eum et Lucky saltabant.

source: The silly wolf looked like he was having the time of his life.
target: Lupus ineptus videbatur quasi summo gaudio vitae suae frueretur.

source: Half an hour later, he was standing in the middle of a field filled with corpses of giant grasshoppers, breathing heavily, but smiling triumphantly.
target: Dimidio hora post, in medio agri cadaveribus locustarum gigantum repleto, stetit, grave respirans, sed triumphanter subridens.

source: ‘Apparently, the first hurdle is done…’ was his first thought, and then he froze.
target: ‘Apparenter, primus obstaculum peractum est…’ erat prima cogitatio eius, deinde immobilis factus est.

source: Lucky watched as his master froze for a second, then walked up to the nearest tree and began to bang his head into it while yelling.
target: Lucky spectavit dum magister eius per momentum immobilis factus esset, deinde ad arborem proximam accessit et incoepit caput in eam percussare dum clamitabat.

source: “Stupid! Stupid! Stupid!”
target: “Stultus! Stultus! Stultus!”

source: Sam stopped trying to use concussion to make his idiotic brain forget the fight, and then went to the nearest corpse.
target: Sam cessavit conari uti concussione ut mentem stultam pugnae oblivionem perduceret, deinde ad cadaver proximum accessit.

source: He quickly infused a drop of mana into the tip of his sword, then thrust the sword into the still corpse.
target: Celeriter guttulam manae in aciem gladii infudit, deinde gladium in cadaver quiescentem impulit.

source: He grabbed hold of the drop of mana and, with a violent motion, had it burst inside the carcass.
target: Guttulam manae arripuit et, vi motu violento, intra cadaver illam erupit.

source: Instead of an explosion of gore, he was rewarded by the grasshopper corpse turning rainbow‐colored, and then, in the next instant, shattering into a million little pieces and sinking into the ground, vanishing from sight.
target: Pro explosione cruentis non, compensatus est quod cadaver locustae in colores iridis vertit, deinde, in proximo momento, in innumeros frustulos dissolutum atque in terram delapsum, conspectu evanuit.

source: “Of course they are illusions! You were told it is using illusions…” he grumbled under his breath as he spread his mana as thin as possible and enveloped all the corpses he could see and sense.
target: “Scilicet, illae sunt illusiones! Audisti enim eam illusiones uti…” mormoravit sub ore dum manam suam tenuissime ferebat et omnia cadavera, quae videre atque sentire poterat, involvit.

source: Then the next second the entire scene was filled with rainbow light, then nothing but the slightly torn‐up forest, no grasshopper, but a very confused Lucky sitting in the middle.
target: Deinde, in proximo momento, tota scena luce iridis plena facta est, deinde nihil nisi silva leviter laniata, nullae locustae, sed Lucky valde confusus in medio sedens.

source: Sam just sat down next to the confused Lucky with a huff and began petting the wolf.
target: Sam statim iuxta Lucky confundum sedebat, cum suspirio, et lupum fovere coepit.

source: After trying to ignore his blunder, Sam took a breather, and continued on his journey, while lambasting himself for forgetting that he was dealing with an illusion‐using monster.
target: Postquam conatus est suum errorem neglegere, Sam paulum quiescit et iter suum continuavit, simul se ipsum reprehendens quod oblitum esset se cum monstrum ut illusionum utens versari.

source: Though at least he now knew beyond a shadow of a doubt that he was in the correct place.
target: At saltem iam sciebat sine minima dubitatione se in loco recto esse.

source: He took hold of part of his mana and expelled it from his body, trying to spread it as thin as possible while still keeping it connected to himself.
target: Partem manae suae arripuit eamque ex corpore suo expulsit, conatus eam tenuari quantum fieri potuit, simul tamen ad se ligatam servans.

source: Sam knew from his inherited memories that illusions could be broken.
target: Sam ex memoriis hereditariis sciebat illusiones frangi posse.

source: Few and far were those that couldn’t, and most of those were either cast by legendary mages or anchored to artifacts deep in ancient ruins.
target: Pauci erant qui frangi non poterant, et plerique eorum aut ab magis praeclaris magiis evocati erant aut ad artifacta profunde in antiquis ruinis coniuncti.

source: When he judged that the mana was spread far enough from him, in a crude globe, he paused for a second, then began to vibrate the mana in the surrounding cloud.
target: Cum iudicavit manam satis longe a se diffusa esse in globulo rudis, momento cessit, deinde manam in nube circumjacenti vibratoriam facere coepit.

source: To his dismay, the scene of the forest rushing past him shattered, and he found himself back in a very familiar field, with a very confused Lucky sitting in the middle and watching him with concern.
target: Ad magnam eius maerorem, scena silvae praeter eum festinanter traiciebatur dissoluta est, atque se invenit in agro valde noto, cum Lucky valde confuso in medio sedens eumque sollicitus intuentem.

source: “Fuuuuuuuh…”
target: “Fuuuuuuuh…”

source: He sighed and began rolling up (metaphorically) his sleeves.
target: Suspiravit et manicas suas (metaphorice) volvere coepit.

source: ‘This is going to take a while.’
target: ‘Hoc tempus aliquantum capiet.’

source: Sam’s second attempt went almost the same.
target: Secunda conatus Sam fere idem exsecutus est.

source: He shot off towards his direction with the cloud of illusion‐disrupting mana already primed, yet the moment he activated it, he found himself back in the clearing.
target: Festinavit in suam partem cum nube manae, quae ad illusiones dissolvendas iam praeparata erat, sed eodem momento quo eam activavit, se in prato invenit.

source: Just to make sure he wasn’t imagining, and holding to the adage that ‘if you can’t repeat it, it ain’t science’, he did two more times, exactly the same.
target: Ut certus esset se non imaginari, et ad dicendum quod ‘si iterari non potest, non est scientia’ tenens, bis iter fecit, prorsus idem.

source: And his experiments were validated.
target: Et experimenta eius confirmata sunt.

source: It took exactly the same time to break the illusion and find himself back in the empty field.
target: Eodem tempore exacto illusionem frangere atque se in agro vacuo iterum invenire potuit.

source: Then he went out without the disruption field and just kept rushing ahead, pumping his Body Enhancement to the maximum.
target: Deinde, campo disruptionis carente, egressus est et tantum properabat, incrementum corporis ad maximum impellens.

source: However, after a few minutes, he noticed something that he overlooked the first time.
target: Sed post paucis minutis, aliquid animadvertit quod primo negligere fecerat.

source: Some trees were repeating themselves.
target: Quaedam arbores se repetebant.

source: ‘Oh, look, this is the second time I've seen that flower…’ Sam remarked to himself as he slowed down and stopped in front of a simple yellow flower resembling a marigold.
target: ‘O, ecce, iterum hanc florem vidi…’ inquit Sam sibi, dum tardabat et coram simplici flori flavo, marigold simili, sistit.

source: With a quiet sigh, he activated his disruption field and found himself back in the clearing, with a very confused Lucky, who watched him with a tilted head, and a tongue lolling out.
target: Cum quieto suspirio, campum disruptionis activavit et se iterum in prato invenit, cum Lucky maxime confuso, qui capite inclinato eum observabat, et lingua laxe pendente.

source: For the next hour, he tried several ways to escape the situation.
target: Pro hora sequenti, varias vias conatus est ad exitu e statu evadendi.

source: He tried going super fast, super slow, tried it backward, sideways, even zig‐zagging but nothing worked.
target: Celeriter nimis, tardius, retrorsum, lateraliter, etiam in formis zigzag conatus est, sed nihil profuit.

source: He tried going back towards the Candle rock, but even when he tried to leave the place, he still found himself back in the clearing where he fought the illusionary grasshoppers.
target: Conatus est reverti versus Saxum Candelarum, sed etiam cum locum relinquere conaretur, se in prato, ubi cum locustis illusoriis pugnaverat, iterum invenit.

source: He tried staying in the clearing and disrupting the illusion by stretching his mana even further, but the only thing that happened was that he heard a small noise, akin to a crystal globe shattering, and nothing more.
target: Conatus est in prato manere et illusionem minuere manam suam ulterius distendens, sed solum evenit ut parvus sonus, similis globi crystallini confracti, audiret, et nihil aliud.

source: Afterwards, the way out was still blocked by the illusion.
target: Postea, via exitus adhuc ab illusionem obstructa manebat.

source: Sam even tried going out, as if heading towards his goal, and then just unleashing some devastating attacks.
target: Sam etiam conatus est exire, quasi ad finem suum tendens, deinde impetuosos impetus efferens.

source: The only response to that was a giant army of grasshoppers swarming him and the burning forest around him.
target: Solum responsum ad id fuit ingens exercitus locustarum, eum et silvam ardentem circum eum inflammans.

source: While Sam appreciated the opportunity to practice and hone his sword skills, it was not the goal he was aiming for.
target: Dum Sam occasionem aestimabat ad peritia gladiatoria exercenda et perficienda, id non erat propositum ad quod contendebat.

source: So, feeling a little frustrated, he let out a yell and charged into the horde of grasshoppers with Lucky at his side.
target: Itaque, paulo frustratus, clamitavit et in turbam locustarum impetum dedit, cum Lucky iuxta se.

source: He made sure his stance was solid, but otherwise, he kept spamming his skills, trying to get a true feel for them, practicing with them, and so on.
target: Curot ut habitus eius solidus esset, sed cetera, facultates suas crebro adhibebat, verum sensum iis adipisci conatus, eas exercens, et ita porro.

source: Lucky was just having fun…
target: Lucky tantum ludeat…

source: For half an hour, after getting almost killed by a kaiju‐sized grasshopper and quickly shattering the illusions, he logged out, took a water break and tried to organize the information he acquired into something resembling a form.
target: Per dimidiam horam, postquam paene a locusta magnitudine kaiju interfectus est et celeriter illusiones dissolvit, se discessit, aquae refrigerium cepit et conatus est informationes collectas in formam aliquam ordinare.

source: Luckily, by the time he returned to the game, he had something approaching a game plan.
target: Fortunate, cum ad ludum rediret, aliquid consilii ludendi quasi paratum habebat.

source: He continued as he did before, trying different things, charging this and that way. Shooting off attacks at random things, pretending to be getting angry.
target: Praeteritis modis continuavit, variis rebus conatus, hinc illuc impetum dabat, impetus casu in res misos iaciens, simul se iratum esse simulans.

source: A few times, just for the fun of it, he redid the Attack of Grasshopper scenario. He found it rather therapeutic…
target: Aliquot vicibus, solum ad ludicrum, scenarium Impetus Locustae iteravit. Id ei satis therapeuticum videbatur…

source: But finally, after several hours of fruitless action, he felt he was ready.
target: Sed tandem, post varias horas inanis actionis, sensit se paratum esse.

source: It was a risky move, but based on the hints and information he gathered from his inherited memories, and his actual knowledge of mythology and somewhat dubious knowledge he gained from reading all those isekai and gaming novels.
target: Consilium periculosum fuit, sed indicibus et informationibus ex memoriis hereditatis colligendis, atque ex vera mythologiae scientia et paulo dubia, quam ex libris isekai et ludorum fabulis percepit, innixus est.

source: For a moment, he closed his eyes, resisted the temptation to check the skill level‐up notifications, as he knew the system took that into account when determining results and enemy strength, even the final reward sometimes, then opened them, and for the last time he rushed off, directly towards his goal, burning enough mana to make a lot of mages jealous.
target: Per momentum oculos clausit, temptationi inspiciendorum notificationum de incremento artis resistit, quoniam sciebat systema id habere in rationem cum exitus et hostium vim computaret, etiam finalem praemium aliquando, deinde eos aperuit, et ad novissimum tempus, directe ad finem suum, festinavit, satis manae comburens ut multos magos invidiosos efficeret.

source: Then, just as Sam did so many tries previously, he reached inside himself, grasped the mana circulating there, drew out a good chunk of it, and using the by now routine ability, and with a small twist of his mana, shattered the illusionary world around him.
target: Deinde, sicut antea Sam multas conatus habuerat, intra se pervenit, manam ibi circulantem arripuit, bonam partem eius extraxit, et usu iam solito, cum parva torsione manae, orbem illusionis circa se frangit.

source: Sam found himself back in the clearing, still as he left it, though with a few more craters and scars.
target: Sam se invenit iterum in prato, quo reliquerat, quamquam paucis crateribus et cicatricibus additis.

source: Lucky was again, back in the middle, watching him confusedly.
target: Lucky iterum in medio sedebat, eum confusim spectans.

source: The poor thing had no idea what was going on…
target: Miserus ille nesciebat quid ageretur…

source: Then Sam started on his plan.
target: Deinde Sam consilium suum inchoavit.

source: “What the hell? What the frick is going on?” he exclaimed, acting as angry as he could be, while stomping around, making sure that his mana was churning around him, showcasing his anger.
target: “Quid diablotinum? Quid hoc vehementer agitur?” exclamavit, furibundus quantum poterat, dum circumcalcans, curans ut mana eius circa se turbinebatur, iram suam ostendens.

source: He continued to do this for a few minutes, angrily jumping and stomping around the clearing without any aim.
target: Hoc per paucos minutas continuavit, irate saltans et calcibus per prato calcans sine ullo proposito.

source: Then, after completing a circle around the now worried Lucky, he stealthily reached inside his inventory and retrieved the sparklescale powder he purchased just in case, and began to prepare it.
target: Deinde, post circulum circa nunc sollicitum Lucky perfecit, furtim in sua saccula accessit et pulvisum squamae scintillantis, quem ad casum emerat, rapuit atque praeparare coepit.

source: Sparklescale powder came from grinding down scales of the Sparklescale Mollusk, which could be found in certain seas, but could be bred pretty easily anywhere, with some know‐how.
target: Pulvis squamae scintillantis ex squamis mollusci Sparklescale molendis oriebatur, qui in quibusdam mari reperiri poterant, sed ubique faciliter aleri possent, si scientia esset.

source: Their scaled shell was pretty good at disrupting magic, and if the Sparklescale Mollusk was allowed to mature, that disruption turned into outright magic resistance.
target: Tegmen eorum squamosum efficaciter magiam perturbabat, et si molluscus Sparklescale maturari liceret, illa perturbatio in veram repugnationem magicae convertere videbatur.

source: They were pretty hard enemies to defeat for mages.
target: Hostes erant difficillimi superandi ab magicis.

source: Slowly, under the cover of his churning mana, he separated a tiny thread of mana, and enveloped the small leather bag in his hands that contained the powder.
target: Lente, sub tegmento manae ferventis, tenuem filum manae separavit, et parvum sacculum coriaceum manibus suis, quod pulverem continebat, involvit.

source: Holding it as if it was a snow globe.
target: Tenens eum tamquam globum nivale.

source: Still continuing his angry stomp through the clearing, and when he was in the middle with Lucky jumping out of his way with a small yelp, he suddenly stopped, and with a flex of his will, shot the globe of mana containing the bag of sparklescale powder, and with another exertion of his will detonated the bag over the clearing.
target: Adhuc iratus per pratum calcans, et cum in médio esset, Lucky parvo clamo extrorsum saliens, subito sistit, et cum voluntatis suae flexu globum manae, quod sacculum pulveris squamae scintillantis continebat, proiecit, ac alio impetu voluntatis sacculus super prato detonatus est.

source: Instantly, sparkling powder began falling on the clearing like snow and, with his senses cranked up to eleven, he could immediately feel the illusionary construct around him waver.
target: Statim, pulveris scintillantis instar nivis in pratum cadere coepit, et sensibus suis ad undecim excitatis, statim sentire potuit constructionem illusionis circa se vacillare.

source: Yet, he knew it wasn’t the same as when Sam did the same with his own mana.
target: Tamen sciebat id non eundem esse ac cum Sam idem cum sua mana fecisset.

source: After all, he was rather amateurish with his attempts and the scale powder was permanent and one would defend against it differently than against simple mana disruptions.
target: Nam conatus eius satis ineptus erant, et pulvis squamae perpetuus, quem aliter defendere oportebat quam adversus simplices disruptiones manae.

source: His hope was that the monster was originally from the area and had no knowledge of the intricacies of the deep sea mollusk lives.
target: Spes eius erat ut monstrum ex illa regione originem haberet et de subtilitatibus vitae molluscorum profundae maris nihil noverit.

source: And as he reined in his own churning mana, while slowly petting Lucky as he sat practically on his legs, he looked around and couldn’t help but let out a satisfied smile as his eyes zeroed on an area near the edge of the clearing next to a most stereotypical tree stump that Sam had ever seen.
target: Et dum manam suam ferventem moderabatur, lente Lucky fovens, qui quasi in cruribus eius sedebat, circumspiciens, non potuit non subridere satisfacta vultu, cum oculi eius in aream prope limitem prati, iuxta truncum arboreum maxime stereotipum, quem Sam umquam viderat, inciderent.
